marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Nasa. vol. 1 a space odyssey, mankinds incredible journey into space

"With these words began the most ambitious program mankind has ever undertaken; to free ourselves from our earthly confines and explore space. From the first Gemini mission to the space shuttle, this is teh story of the National Aeronautic Space Administration; a race for space which became the pinnacle of human achievement in the 20th Century. From the incredible rescue of Apollo 13 to routine satellite launches from the space shuttle, come with us on a journey through history to distant galaxies, black holes and the origin of the universe itself. " --Container
